apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription: Boot schedule: 20° today (Oct 18), 15° Wed Oct 21, 10° Sat Oct 24, 5° Tue Oct 27, neutral Fri Oct 30. Hinge-day reminders follow it.
Pocket mode now shows the exercise name: what's next during rests, what you're starting during setup. It's brighter for a few seconds when it changes.

Pocket mode: tap the phone icon during a session for a black screen that ignores touches (hold 1 second to come back); vibrations keep working. New strip at the bottom shows every exercise in the session and how far you are.
